I've found the cause. I haven't changed anything yet, because what counts as "important" is your call.

## Why the lists are noisy

Both lists come from the same function, `needsOfWork()` in `server/home.js:146`. Home uses it through `homeOf()` and the project page through `needsOfProject()`, so a fix there covers both pages and the count in the bar. It adds a row for five reasons, and most of the rows come from three of them:

1. **"Turn finished" rows, one per session.** `server/home.js:193` goes through every session from the last week, in every design and every fix. Any session whose last turn you haven't opened adds a row, even after a newer session in the same design has replaced it. A turn only counts as seen if you opened that session's page or were watching it when it ended. If you left while the agent worked, which is most of the time, it becomes a row. So a design worked on over four sessions this week can leave four rows.
2. **"Ready to build" and "Pull request open" rows repeat what's already on the page.** On the project page, the Designs list already shows "Ready to build" (R-r6b) and In progress already shows "Pull request open". On Home, each project card's In progress line already says "Pull request open" or "N pages to build". These rows also never expire.
3. **No limit per design.** One design can show a pull request, a ready-to-build row and several finished turns all at once.

## What I'd suggest

Keep only what you have to act on:

- **Keep:** "Asking you", "Build stopped", and a turn that **ended with an error**.
- **Drop:** a turn that finished normally. It still shows as "Turn finished" in the design's In progress line.
- **Drop:** "Ready to build" and "Pull request open" from Needs you. They stay where they already appear: the Designs pill and filter, the In progress pills, and the Home cards. Their wording stays as it is.

The bar's count would drop to match, because it counts the same list.

This reverses two of your earlier decisions: from 2026-10-16, "Needs you includes finished turns", and the R-8hc week of expiry. It also changes rules R-n4v, R-8hc, R-w2k and R-v7q. That's why I'm asking before I make it.

**Which would you like?**
- **(a)** The suggestion above.
- **(b)** Something lighter: keep finished turns, but only the newest session's per design, and keep "Ready to build" and "Pull request open".
- **(c)** Your own mix, or leave it for a design session on the Landing Page.

Once you choose, I'll change `server/home.js`, update both designs (the needs in their states, their RULES.md and NOTES.md), and update the tests in `test/home.test.js`.
